restaurantName: La Table de Jean-Paul Tossens - Monastère de Saint-Mont
bio: To say this place is steeped in history is an understatement: the monastery, rebuilt several times since the Middle Ages, is said to stand on the site of a Roman oppidum. The chef revisits French cuisine through a seasonal lens, showcasing premium ingredients, and serving up his dishes in an elegant setting. Guestrooms available; hotel facilities include swimming pool and spa....
